vo.text: Your phone can find you without mobile signal or internet.
vo.speak: Your phone can find you without mobile signal or internet.

vo.text: The map may need data. GPS itself does not.
vo.speak: The map may need data. G P S itself does not.

vo.text: GPS satellites orbit about twenty thousand kilometres above Earth.
vo.speak: G P S satellites orbit about twenty thousand kilometres above Earth.

vo.text: Each one carries an extremely accurate atomic clock.
vo.speak: Each one carries an extremely accurate atomic clock.

vo.text: and the exact time its signal was sent.
vo.speak: and the exact time its signal was sent.

vo.text: Your phone measures how long that signal took to arrive.
vo.speak: Your phone measures how long that signal took to arrive.

vo.text: The timing must be astonishingly precise.
vo.speak: The timing must be astonishingly precise.

vo.text: Because radio waves travel at the speed of light, delay becomes distance.
vo.speak: Because radio waves travel at the speed of light, delay becomes distance.

vo.text: One satellite gives a distance, not a fix.
vo.speak: One satellite gives a distance, not a fix.

vo.text: Three satellites help find your position. A fourth corrects your phone's clock.
vo.speak: Three satellites help find your position. A fourth corrects your phone's clock.

vo.text: Without that correction, the position would be wrong.
vo.speak: Without that correction, the position would be wrong.

vo.text: Imagine invisible spheres around the satellites.
vo.speak: Imagine invisible spheres around the satellites.

vo.text: Where the distances meet is your location. That's trilateration.
vo.speak: Where the distances meet is your location. That's trilateration.

vo.text: So GPS is a cosmic stopwatch.
vo.speak: So G P S is a cosmic stopwatch.

vo.text: Satellites send the time. Your phone turns tiny delays into a dot on the map.
vo.speak: Satellites send the time. Your phone turns tiny delays into a dot on the map.
